focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制全面执行在即，中国出口企业须重构碳成本核算与申报链条
focus.summary: 欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起对钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥、电力及氢等产品正式征收碳关税。中国出口商需尽快建立产品嵌入碳排放的核算体系，并确保上游供应商提供经核查的排放数据。未合规申报将面临高额罚金及货物滞留风险。建议企业提前与欧盟进口商对接，明确申报责任分配，并评估在第三国布局低碳产能的可行性。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会气候行动总司 · 2026.10.08
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Enforcement Looms: Chinese Exporters Must Overhaul Carbon Cost Accounting and Reporting Chains
focus.summary_en: The EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transitional period ends in late 2026, with definitive carbon tariffs applying from 2027 to steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers, electricity and hydrogen. Chinese exporters must urgently build systems to calculate embedded emissions and secure verified data from upstream suppliers. Non-compliant reporting risks hefty penalties and cargo delays. Companies should engage EU importers early to clarify reporting obligations and assess low-carbon production in third countries.

case.title: 新加坡上诉庭确立跨境数据泄露仲裁可赔精神损害，中企出海需审视数据合规条款
case.summary: 新加坡上诉庭近期在一宗跨境数据泄露仲裁案中裁定，因企业过失导致客户个人信息外泄，受影响个人可就精神损害获得赔偿，且仲裁条款可覆盖未具名的第三方受益人。该判决对在东南亚运营的中国科技与电商企业影响深远，意味着数据合规瑕疵可能触发集体仲裁风险。建议中企在跨境合同中明确数据保护责任、赔偿上限及争议解决机制，并投保网络安全责任险。
case.source: 来源：新加坡上诉庭 · 2026年9月
case.title_en: Singapore Appellate Court Allows Emotional Damages in Cross-Border Data Breach Arbitration, Prompting Chinese Firms to Review Data Clauses
case.summary_en: Singapore's appellate court recently ruled in a cross-border data breach arbitration that individuals affected by a company's negligence in leaking personal data may recover damages for emotional distress, and arbitration clauses can extend to unnamed third-party beneficiaries. This decision has significant implications for Chinese tech and e-commerce firms operating in Southeast Asia, as data compliance failures may trigger class arbitration risks. Companies should clarify data protection duties, liability caps and dispute resolution in cross-border contracts, and consider cyber liability insurance.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区推出跨境商事纠纷“一站式”在线解纷平台，港澳仲裁裁决内地执行再提速
policy.summary: 粤港澳大湾区近期上线跨境商事纠纷“一站式”在线解纷平台，整合三地调解、仲裁与诉讼资源，支持在线立案、证据交换及港澳仲裁裁决在内地的认可与执行申请。平台依托最高人民法院与港澳司法机构的数据互通机制，有望将裁决执行周期缩短30%以上。从事跨境贸易、投资及知识产权业务的企业可优先选用该平台，降低争议解决的时间与费用成本。
policy.source: 来源：粤港澳大湾区法律部门联席会议 · 2026年9月
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Launches One-Stop Online Dispute Resolution Platform, Speeding Up Enforcement of HK/Macao Arbitral Awards in Mainland
policy.summary_en: The Greater Bay Area has launched a one-stop online dispute resolution platform for cross-border commercial disputes, integrating mediation, arbitration and litigation resources across the three jurisdictions. It supports online case filing, evidence exchange and applications for recognition and enforcement of Hong Kong and Macao arbitral awards in the mainland. Backed by data-sharing between the Supreme People's Court and HK/Macao judicial bodies, the platform is expected to cut enforcement timelines by over 30%. Businesses in cross-border trade, investment and IP should prioritise this platform to reduce time and costs.
policy.source_en: Source: GBA Legal Departments Joint Conference · September 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查新规扩围，中企须建立“投资+技术+数据”三维合规防火墙
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国近期拟将对外投资审查范围扩大至人工智能、量子计算及生物技术等领域的合资与绿地投资，并强化对“规避行为”的穿透式监管。中企在美或第三国的技术合作、人员交流及数据跨境均可能被纳入审查。建议企业立即开展存量项目合规筛查，在交易文件中加入“监管变化”条款与分手费安排，并建立技术出口与数据流动的内部审批流程，避免因单点违规引发连锁制裁。
analysis.source: 来源：律连全球 · iGlobal Law 研究部 · 2026.10.08
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: New US Outbound Investment Rules Expand Scope; Chinese Firms Need a Three-Dimensional Compliance Firewall for Investment, Technology and Data
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US is poised to expand its outbound investment screening to joint ventures and greenfield investments in AI, quantum computing and biotechnology, with enhanced look-through scrutiny of circumvention. Chinese firms' technology cooperation, personnel exchanges and cross-border data flows in the US or third countries may all be captured. Companies should immediately audit existing projects, incorporate regulatory-change clauses and break fees in transaction documents, and establish internal approval processes for technology exports and data flows to avoid cascading sanctions from a single violation.
